community.description: Share sanitized probe results and public model prices with your review site to improve live station ratings. Off by default; you must opt in.
community.endpointHint: Enter the API base URL only, e.g. https://ratings.example.com/api/v1; the client appends /probes and /prices.
community.hashUrlHint: Recommended: the site receives a station hash instead of the cleartext domain.
community.privacy: Privacy promise: API keys, access tokens, absolute balances, and personal data are never uploaded. Only verdicts, metrics such as latency, and public prices are shared.

community.title: Contribute anonymous verification data

description: Seven standardized checks that verify a relay site serves the model you pay for. Each run costs a few tokens; reports stay local.

dialog.apiKeyDescription: This account has several API keys. Choose the one to use for this run.

labels.accessTokenHint: Access token from the site's personal-settings page; required by the billing probe
labels.apiKeyHint: sk- style key used by chat and streaming probes
labels.billingNote: The billing probe reads quota before/after one billed request via /api/user/self; it needs the access token and user id.
labels.userIdHint: Numeric user id for the New-Api-User header

billing.hint: Reconciles the actual deduction against the expected cost
billing.label: Billing

cache.hint: Two random-code echoes to catch cached answers
cache.label: Cache replay

consistency.hint: Compares against a stored baseline to catch silent swaps
consistency.label: Consistency

identity.hint: Cross-checks the self-reported model family to catch substitution
identity.label: Identity

injection.hint: Detects injected system prompts or downgrading
injection.label: Injection

reach.hint: Is the site up and how fast it answers
reach.label: Reachability

stream.hint: Time-to-first-token and chunk count to catch fake streaming
stream.label: Streaming

status.apiKeyFetchFailed: Failed to fetch the API key. Make sure you are logged in to this relay site, then retry.
status.apiKeyMissing: This account has no usable API key, or the site does not reveal the key. Enter it manually.
status.autoFetchDone: Access token and user ID filled automatically.
status.autoFetchFailed: Auto-fill failed. Make sure you are logged in to this relay site in the browser, then retry.
status.autoFetchIdentityMismatch: The browser session is signed in to a different account than the one selected. Switch accounts and retry.
status.autoFetchLoginRequired: Fetch failed: sign in to this relay site in the current tab, then retry.
status.autoFetchNoToken: User ID filled, but the site returned no access token. Enter it manually.
status.autoFetchUnsupported: This account's site type does not support auto-fill. Enter the values manually.
status.needKey: Select an account, enter the API key, then load models.
status.noAccounts: No accounts yet. Add one in Account Management first.
